name: Day 8 — 剪頭髮與簡報 Fresh Cut, Big Pitch

qs.q: Why does he get a haircut today?
What does he ask the stylist?
How does he feel afterward?

gram.d: The service-request frame: 請幫我剪短一點 — please cut it a bit shorter for me. 幫我 turns any verb into a polite ask: 幫我看一下, 幫我拿.

qs.q: What happens before the cut?
ch: A hair wash with head massage

qs.q: What does the assistant ask?
What does he ask for with the cut?

gram.d: A 跟 B 一樣 = A is the same as B: 跟上次一樣 same as last time; 跟我想的不一樣 — not what I imagined. Add an adjective for comparisons: 跟他一樣高.

readings.title: 設計師的建議 The Stylist's Pitch

qs.q: What does the stylist suggest first?
How does he decline?
ch: 不用，下次再說 with a smile

qs.q: What service does he stick with?

gram.d: The gold-standard polite refusal: 'not for now — next time.' 先 softens (just for now), 下次再說 leaves the door open. Works on upsells, invitations, and pushy relatives alike.

readings.title: 簡報練習 Rehearsing the Pitch

qs.q: What order do they settle on?
What are the two key points?
What is Xiao Chen's advice about nerves?

gram.d: The presentation skeleton: 先講產品，再講結果，最後講價格 — first, then, finally. Day 1's 先…再 grown into a full outline; narrate any process with it.

gram.d: News-register future: 政府將推出新計畫 — the government will roll out new programs. Written/broadcast Chinese uses 將 where speech uses 會; spotting it instantly marks a text as formal.

dict.zh: 你的頭髮好長喔！
dict.py: Nǐ de tóufǎ hǎo cháng o!
dict.en: Your hair's gotten so long!

dict.zh: 我想剪短一點。
dict.py: Wǒ xiǎng jiǎn duǎn yìdiǎn.
dict.en: I'd like it a bit shorter.

dict.zh: 剪完頭髮，你好帥！
dict.py: Jiǎn wán tóufǎ, nǐ hǎo shuài!
dict.en: After the cut you look so sharp!

dict.zh: 我每兩個月剪一次頭髮。
dict.py: Wǒ měi liǎng ge yuè jiǎn yícì tóufǎ.
dict.en: I get a haircut every two months.

dict.zh: 這家店要先預約嗎？
dict.py: Zhè jiā diàn yào xiān yùyuē ma?
dict.en: Does this place need a reservation?

pass.zh: 欸，你剪頭髮了喔？看起來好帥！是在公司附近那家剪的嗎？我也想去，下次帶我去！

qs.q: What did the speaker notice?
What do they want?
ch: To be taken along next time

dict.zh: 先幫您洗頭，請跟我來。
dict.py: Xiān bāng nín xǐ tóu, qǐng gēn wǒ lái.
dict.en: We'll wash your hair first — this way please.

dict.zh: 水會不會太熱？
dict.py: Shuǐ huì bú huì tài rè?
dict.en: Is the water too hot?

dict.zh: 跟上次一樣，短一點就好。
dict.py: Gēn shàngcì yíyàng, duǎn yìdiǎn jiù hǎo.
dict.en: Same as last time — just a bit shorter.

dict.zh: 鏡子看一下，這樣可以嗎？
dict.py: Jìngzi kàn yíxià, zhèyàng kěyǐ ma?
dict.en: Check the mirror — is this okay?

dict.zh: 吹好了，超帥的啦！
dict.py: Chuī hǎo le, chāo shuài de la!
dict.en: All blow-dried — looking sharp!

pass.zh: 歡迎光臨！先幫您洗頭按摩，然後設計師幫您剪。今天人比較多，可能要等十分鐘，先喝杯茶吧！

qs.q: What happens first?
Why the ten-minute wait?

dict.zh: 要不要順便染一個顏色？
dict.py: Yào bú yào shùnbiàn rǎn yíge yánsè?
dict.en: Want to dye it a color while we're at it?

dict.zh: 我先不用，謝謝。
dict.py: Wǒ xiān búyòng, xièxie.
dict.en: Not for now, thanks.

dict.zh: 這次想換什麼髮型？
dict.py: Zhècì xiǎng huàn shénme fǎxíng?
dict.en: What style change this time?

dict.zh: 護髮加一百五就好喔。
dict.py: Hùfǎ jiā yìbǎi wǔ jiù hǎo o.
dict.en: The treatment is only 150 extra.

dict.zh: 下次再說，今天洗剪吹就好。
dict.py: Xiàcì zài shuō, jīntiān xǐjiǎnchuī jiù hǎo.
dict.en: Maybe next time — just wash-cut-dry today.

pass.zh: 設計師一直問我要不要染頭髮、要不要燙、要不要加護髮。我都笑著說先不用。最後只花五百塊洗剪吹，設計師還是很親切。拒絕沒關係，有禮貌就好！

qs.q: How many upsells did the stylist try?
How did he refuse?
What did he end up paying?

dict.zh: 星期三的簡報準備好了嗎？
dict.py: Xīngqí sān de jiǎnbào zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?
dict.en: Is Wednesday's presentation ready?

dict.zh: 我們先練習一次順序。
dict.py: Wǒmen xiān liànxí yícì shùnxù.
dict.en: Let's run through the order once first.

dict.zh: 重點是售後服務跟交貨時間。
dict.py: Zhòngdiǎn shì shòuhòu fúwù gēn jiāohuò shíjiān.
dict.en: The key points are after-sales service and delivery time.

dict.zh: 不要緊張，多練習幾次就好。
dict.py: Búyào jǐnzhāng, duō liànxí jǐ cì jiù hǎo.
dict.en: Don't be nervous — a few more run-throughs and you're set.

dict.zh: 王先生可能會問折扣的事。
dict.py: Wáng xiānshēng kěnéng huì wèn zhékòu de shì.
dict.en: Mr. Wang will probably ask about the discount.

pass.zh: Eric，下午三點會議室練習簡報，記得帶電腦。我們把順序跑兩次：你講產品跟技術，我講價格。王先生最在意交貨時間，這部分你多準備一點。辛苦了！

qs.q: When and where is the rehearsal?
How do they split the presentation?
ch: Eric does product and tech, Xiao Chen does price

qs.q: What does Mr. Wang care about most?

dict.zh: 服務業缺工的問題越來越嚴重。
dict.py: Fúwùyè quēgōng de wèntí yuèláiyuè yánzhòng.
dict.en: The service-industry labor shortage keeps worsening.

dict.zh: 業者表示，薪資已經調高了。
dict.py: Yèzhě biǎoshì, xīnzī yǐjīng tiáogāo le.
dict.en: Operators say wages have already been raised.

dict.zh: 人力不足，只好縮短營業時間。
dict.py: Rénlì bùzú, zhǐhǎo suōduǎn yíngyè shíjiān.
dict.en: Short on staff, they can only cut business hours.

dict.zh: 專家指出，自動化只能解決一部分。
dict.py: Zhuānjiā zhǐchū, zìdònghuà zhǐ néng jiějué yíbùfèn.
dict.en: Experts note automation solves only part of it.

dict.zh: 政府將推出新的訓練計畫。
dict.py: Zhèngfǔ jiāng tuīchū xīn de xùnliàn jìhuà.
dict.en: The government will roll out new training programs.

pass.zh: 財經新聞：服務業缺工問題持續擴大，不少店家縮短營業時間。業者表示薪資調高了一成，還是找不到人。學者認為，除了加薪，工作環境與發展機會同樣重要；科技業搶人才的情況，也讓傳統服務業更難留人。

qs.q: How much have wages been raised?
Besides pay, what do scholars say matters?
What makes retention even harder?

scenarios.intro: Wednesday needs a sharp look. Walk in, say what you want, survive the mirror check, and book ahead like a regular.

them.zh: 你好！今天想怎麼剪？
them.py: Nǐ hǎo! Jīntiān xiǎng zěnme jiǎn?
them.en: Hi! How are we cutting it today?

turns.task: Ask them to cut it a bit shorter — you're meeting a client Wednesday.

ans.zh: 請幫我剪短一點，我星期三要見客戶。
ans.py: Qǐng bāng wǒ jiǎn duǎn yìdiǎn, wǒ xīngqí sān yào jiàn kèhù.
ans.en: A bit shorter please — I'm meeting a client Wednesday.

them.zh: 了解！旁邊也要短嗎？
them.py: Liǎojiě! Pángbiān yě yào duǎn ma?
them.en: Got it! Short on the sides too?

turns.task: Yes — sides shorter, but not too short on top.

ans.zh: 對，旁邊短一點，上面不要太短。
ans.py: Duì, pángbiān duǎn yìdiǎn, shàngmiàn búyào tài duǎn.
ans.en: Yes — shorter sides, not too short on top.

them.zh: 好的！（剪完）你看鏡子，這樣可以嗎？
them.py: Hǎo de! (jiǎn wán) Nǐ kàn jìngzi, zhèyàng kěyǐ ma?
them.en: Sure! (after the cut) Check the mirror — how's this?

turns.task: It looks great — say you're very satisfied, and you look handsome!

ans.zh: 很好看！我很滿意，好帥！
ans.py: Hěn hǎokàn! Wǒ hěn mǎnyì, hǎo shuài!
ans.en: Looks great — very satisfied. So sharp!

them.zh: 哈哈，謝謝！一共五百塊。
them.py: Hāhā, xièxie! Yígòng wǔbǎi kuài.
them.en: Haha, thanks! That's 500.

turns.task: Pay, and ask: next time, do you need to book in advance?

ans.zh: 給你。請問下次要先預約嗎？
ans.py: Gěi nǐ. Qǐngwèn xiàcì yào xiān yùyuē ma?
ans.en: Here you go. Should I book ahead next time?

them.zh: 週末最好預約，平日直接來就可以！
them.py: Zhōumò zuìhǎo yùyuē, píngrì zhíjiē lái jiù kěyǐ!
them.en: Book for weekends; weekdays just walk in!

turns.task: Got it — thank them, see you in two months!

ans.zh: 我知道了，謝謝！兩個月後見！
ans.py: Wǒ zhīdào le, xièxie! Liǎng ge yuè hòu jiàn!
ans.en: Got it, thanks! See you in two months!

scenarios.intro: Taiwan's secret luxury: the salon hair wash. Manage water temperature and massage strength like a connoisseur.

them.zh: 請躺好喔！水會不會太熱？
them.py: Qǐng tǎng hǎo o! Shuǐ huì bú huì tài rè?
them.en: Lie back please! Water too hot?

turns.task: It's just right — feels comfortable.

ans.zh: 剛剛好，很舒服。
ans.py: Gānggāng hǎo, hěn shūfú.
ans.en: Just right — feels great.

them.zh: 按摩的力道可以嗎？
them.py: Ànmó de lìdào kěyǐ ma?
them.en: How's the massage pressure?

turns.task: Ask for a little stronger — you like it firm.

ans.zh: 可以大力一點嗎？我喜歡大力一點。
ans.py: Kěyǐ dàlì yìdiǎn ma? Wǒ xǐhuān dàlì yìdiǎn.
ans.en: A bit stronger? I like it firm.

them.zh: 沒問題！你的頭髮有一點乾喔。
them.py: Méi wèntí! Nǐ de tóufǎ yǒu yìdiǎn gān o.
them.en: You got it! Your hair's a little dry, by the way.

turns.task: Really? Ask what you should do about it.

ans.zh: 真的嗎？那我應該怎麼辦？
ans.py: Zhēnde ma? Nà wǒ yīnggāi zěnme bàn?
ans.en: Really? What should I do about it?

them.zh: 少用太熱的水洗，就會好很多。
them.py: Shǎo yòng tài rè de shuǐ xǐ, jiù huì hǎo hěnduō.
them.en: Wash with less-hot water — it'll improve a lot.

turns.task: Good tip — say you'll remember that, thanks.

ans.zh: 好建議，我會記得，謝謝妳！
ans.py: Hǎo jiànyì, wǒ huì jìdé, xièxie nǐ!
ans.en: Good tip — I'll remember. Thanks!

them.zh: 洗好囉！請到前面的位子，設計師馬上來。
them.py: Xǐ hǎo luō! Qǐng dào qiánmiàn de wèizi, shèjìshī mǎshàng lái.
them.en: All done! Take the seat up front — the stylist's coming right over.

turns.task: Thank her — the massage was amazing.

ans.zh: 謝謝！妳的按摩真的超舒服！
ans.py: Xièxie! Nǐ de ànmó zhēnde chāo shūfú!
ans.en: Thanks — that massage was incredible!

scenarios.intro: Three upsells are coming: dye, perm, treatment. Decline every one with a smile and zero damage to the relationship — a life skill worth more than the haircut.

them.zh: 欸，你要不要順便染個顏色？很流行喔！
them.py: Éi, nǐ yào bú yào shùnbiàn rǎn ge yánsè? Hěn liúxíng o!
them.en: Hey, want to dye it while we're at it? Very trendy!

turns.task: Smile and decline: not for now, thanks.

ans.zh: 哈哈，我先不用，謝謝！
ans.py: Hāhā, wǒ xiān búyòng, xièxie!
ans.en: Haha, not for now, thanks!

them.zh: 那燙一下呢？你的臉型很適合喔。
them.py: Nà tàng yíxià ne? Nǐ de liǎnxíng hěn shìhé o.
them.en: A light perm then? It'd really suit your face.

turns.task: Deflect with a reason: work requires a simple style — maybe next time.

ans.zh: 我工作需要簡單的髮型，下次再說吧！
ans.py: Wǒ gōngzuò xūyào jiǎndān de fǎxíng, xiàcì zài shuō ba!
ans.en: Work needs me low-key — maybe next time!

them.zh: 好啦！那加個護髮？只要一百五，頭髮會很軟喔。
them.py: Hǎo la! Nà jiā ge hùfǎ? Zhǐyào yìbǎi wǔ, tóufǎ huì hěn ruǎn o.
them.en: Fine! Add a treatment then? Just 150 — makes it so soft.

turns.task: Hold the line, still friendly: today just wash-cut-dry is fine.

ans.zh: 今天洗剪吹就好，謝謝妳的建議！
ans.py: Jīntiān xǐjiǎnchuī jiù hǎo, xièxie nǐ de jiànyì!
ans.en: Just wash-cut-dry today — thanks for the suggestions though!

them.zh: 你很堅持欸，哈哈！好，那就幫你剪帥一點。
them.py: Nǐ hěn jiānchí éi, hāhā! Hǎo, nà jiù bāng nǐ jiǎn shuài yìdiǎn.
them.en: You're firm, haha! Fine — I'll just cut you extra handsome.

turns.task: Joke back: that's the most important service anyway!

ans.zh: 帥最重要，這個服務我要！
ans.py: Shuài zuì zhòngyào, zhège fúwù wǒ yào!
ans.en: Handsome is the key service — that one I'll take!

them.zh: 哈哈哈，沒問題！剪完保證你星期三談生意特別順！
them.py: Hāhāhā, méi wèntí! Jiǎn wán bǎozhèng nǐ xīngqí sān tán shēngyì tèbié shùn!
them.en: Hahaha deal! I guarantee Wednesday's business talk goes extra smooth!

turns.task: Say you're counting on it — the contract depends on this haircut!

ans.zh: 就靠妳了，簽約就看這個頭了！
ans.py: Jiù kào nǐ le, qiānyuē jiù kàn zhège tóu le!
ans.en: It's all on you — the contract rides on this haircut!

scenarios.who: 同事小陳 Coworker Xiao Chen
scenarios.intro: Meeting room, 3 p.m. Set the running order, split the parts, anticipate Mr. Wang's questions, and settle the nerves before Wednesday.

them.zh: 來，我們把星期三的簡報跑一次。你覺得順序怎麼排？
them.py: Lái, wǒmen bǎ xīngqí sān de jiǎnbào pǎo yícì. Nǐ juéde shùnxù zěnme pái?
them.en: Alright, let's run Wednesday's deck once. How would you order it?

turns.task: Propose: product first, then test results, price last.

ans.zh: 先講產品，再講測試結果，最後講價格。
ans.py: Xiān jiǎng chǎnpǐn, zài jiǎng cèshì jiéguǒ, zuìhòu jiǎng jiàgé.
ans.en: Product first, then the test results, price last.

turns.keys: 先產品再結果最後價格

them.zh: 同意。那分工呢？
them.py: Tóngyì. Nà fēngōng ne?
them.en: Agreed. And how do we split it?

turns.task: You take product and tech; he takes price and delivery time.

ans.zh: 我講產品跟技術，你講價格跟交貨時間。
ans.py: Wǒ jiǎng chǎnpǐn gēn jìshù, nǐ jiǎng jiàgé gēn jiāohuò shíjiān.
ans.en: I'll do product and tech; you do price and delivery.

them.zh: 好。你覺得王先生會問什麼？
them.py: Hǎo. Nǐ juéde Wáng xiānshēng huì wèn shénme?
them.en: Good. What do you think Mr. Wang will ask?

turns.task: Predict: the discount for sure, probably after-sales service too — you'll prepare both answers tonight.

ans.zh: 折扣一定會問，售後服務應該也會。我今天晚上把答案準備好。
ans.py: Zhékòu yídìng huì wèn, shòuhòu fúwù yīnggāi yě huì. Wǒ jīntiān wǎnshàng bǎ dá'àn zhǔnbèi hǎo.
ans.en: The discount for sure, probably after-sales too. I'll prep both answers tonight.

them.zh: 很好。欸，你會緊張嗎？
them.py: Hěn hǎo. Éi, nǐ huì jǐnzhāng ma?
them.en: Nice. Hey — you nervous?

turns.task: Admit a little — but say practice makes it better; ask to run it one more time.

ans.zh: 有一點，但是多練習就不緊張了。我們再跑一次吧！
ans.py: Yǒu yìdiǎn, dànshì duō liànxí jiù bù jǐnzhāng le. Wǒmen zài pǎo yícì ba!
ans.en: A little — but practice fixes that. Let's run it once more!

them.zh: 這個態度我喜歡！練完去吃雞排，我請客！
them.py: Zhège tàidù wǒ xǐhuān! Liàn wán qù chī jīpái, wǒ qǐngkè!
them.en: That's the spirit! Chicken cutlets after — my treat!

turns.task: Deal — for chicken cutlets you'll rehearse three more times!

ans.zh: 成交！為了雞排，我可以再練三次！
ans.py: Chéngjiāo! Wèile jīpái, wǒ kěyǐ zài liàn sān cì!
ans.en: Deal! For cutlets I'll run it three more times!

scenarios.intro: Tonight's OPI drill: diagnose why service jobs go unfilled, weigh automation honestly, and propose fixes — then connect it to your own industry's war for talent.

them.zh: 最近很多餐廳、髮廊都找不到人。你覺得缺工的原因是什麼？
them.py: Zuìjìn hěnduō cāntīng, fǎláng dōu zhǎo bú dào rén. Nǐ juéde quēgōng de yuányīn shì shénme?
them.en: Restaurants and salons can't find staff lately. What's driving the shortage?

turns.task: Two main causes: wages too low relative to the work, and long hours with little growth path.

ans.zh: 我認為主要有兩個原因：第一，薪資跟辛苦的程度不成比例；第二，工時長，發展機會又少。
ans.py: Wǒ rènwéi zhǔyào yǒu liǎng ge yuányīn: dì yī, xīnzī gēn xīnkǔ de chéngdù bù chéng bǐlì; dì èr, gōngshí cháng, fāzhǎn jīhuì yòu shǎo.
ans.en: Two main causes: pay isn't proportional to the toil, and hours are long with few growth opportunities.

them.zh: 有人說自動化可以解決，你同意嗎？
them.py: Yǒu rén shuō zìdònghuà kěyǐ jiějué, nǐ tóngyì ma?
them.en: Some say automation solves it. Agree?

turns.task: Partially — machines handle repetitive work, but service depends on human warmth; automation solves manpower, not 人情味.

ans.zh: 我部分同意。重複的工作可以交給機器，但是服務業靠的是人情味，自動化解決人力，解決不了溫度。
ans.py: Wǒ bùfèn tóngyì. Chóngfù de gōngzuò kěyǐ jiāo gěi jīqì, dànshì fúwùyè kào de shì rénqíngwèi, zìdònghuà jiějué rénlì, jiějué bù liǎo wēndù.
ans.en: Partially. Machines can take the repetitive work, but service runs on human warmth — automation fixes manpower, not the human touch.

them.zh: 那你會建議業者怎麼做？
them.py: Nà nǐ huì jiànyì yèzhě zěnme zuò?
them.en: What would you advise business owners to do?

turns.task: Three moves: restructure pay, give clear promotion paths, and use flexible scheduling to attract part-timers.

ans.zh: 三件事：調整薪資結構、給清楚的升遷管道，還有用彈性排班吸引兼職的人。
ans.py: Sān jiàn shì: tiáozhěng xīnzī jiégòu, gěi qīngchǔ de shēngqiān guǎndào, háiyǒu yòng tánxìng páibān xīyǐn jiānzhí de rén.
ans.en: Three things: restructure pay, offer clear promotion paths, and use flexible scheduling to attract part-timers.

them.zh: 你們科技業也搶人搶得很兇吧？
them.py: Nǐmen kējìyè yě qiǎng rén qiǎng de hěn xiōng ba?
them.en: Your tech sector fights hard for people too, no?

turns.task: Very much — the drone industry lacks talent everywhere; your company competes with semiconductors for the same engineers.

ans.zh: 非常兇。無人機產業到處都缺人才，我們還要跟半導體搶同一批工程師。
ans.py: Fēicháng xiōng. Wúrénjī chǎnyè dàochù dōu quē réncái, wǒmen hái yào gēn bàndǎotǐ qiǎng tóng yì pī gōngchéngshī.
ans.en: Fierce. The drone industry is short on talent everywhere — and we're fighting semiconductors for the same engineers.

turns.keys: 缺人才半導體搶工程師

them.zh: 最後，用一句話總結今天的主題吧！
them.py: Zuìhòu, yòng yí jù huà zǒngjié jīntiān de zhǔtí ba!
them.en: Lastly — sum up today's topic in one line!

turns.task: One line: machines can be bought, but people must be respected — whoever respects talent wins the era.

ans.zh: 機器買得到，人才要用尊重換：誰尊重人，誰就贏得這個時代。
ans.py: Jīqì mǎi de dào, réncái yào yòng zūnzhòng huàn: shéi zūnzhòng rén, shéi jiù yíngdé zhège shídài.
ans.en: Machines can be bought; talent is earned with respect — whoever respects people wins this era.

x: 你的頭髮該剪了！
Nǐ de tóufǎ gāi jiǎn le!
Your hair needs a cut!
vocab.n: Taiwan reads 髮 as fǎ. Body hair is 毛 — don't mix them up at the salon.

x: 我下班去剪頭髮。
Wǒ xiàbān qù jiǎn tóufǎ.
I'm getting a haircut after work.
vocab.n: Scissors cut = 剪; knife cut = 切 (as in 雞排要切嗎).

x: 夏天剪短比較涼。
Xiàtiān jiǎn duǎn bǐjiào liáng.
Short hair is cooler in summer.
她的頭髮很長。
Tā de tóufǎ hěn cháng.
Her hair is very long.
vocab.n: Same character read zhǎng means 'to grow / chief' (成長, 校長) — context decides.

x: 吃飯以前要洗手。
Chīfàn yǐqián yào xǐ shǒu.
Wash your hands before eating.
vocab.n: 洗頭 wash hair, 洗澡 shower, 洗衣服 do laundry — one verb, whole hygiene routine.

x: 你看鏡子，這樣可以嗎？
Nǐ kàn jìngzi, zhèyàng kěyǐ ma?
Look in the mirror — is this okay?
我要跟上次一樣的。
Wǒ yào gēn shàngcì yíyàng de.
I'll have the same as last time.
vocab.n: The regular's magic phrase — works at salons, drink stands, and noodle shops alike.

x: 剪完頭髮帥多了！
Jiǎn wán tóufǎ shuài duō le!
Way more handsome after the cut!
vocab.n: 帥哥 = the default friendly address for any man at markets and stalls. For women: 美女.

x: 我的設計師很懂我要什麼。
Wǒ de shèjìshī hěn dǒng wǒ yào shénme.
My stylist really gets what I want.
vocab.n: Same word for hair stylists and design engineers — 工程設計師 crossover for your world.

x: 她染了一個新顏色。
Tā rǎn le yíge xīn yánsè.
She dyed her hair a new color.
小心，湯很燙！
Xiǎoxīn, tāng hěn tàng!
Careful — the soup is scalding!
vocab.n: Double life: 燙頭髮 perm at the salon, 很燙 too-hot food. 湯很燙 = the soup is hot — mind the tones.

x: 這個髮型很適合你。
Zhège fǎxíng hěn shìhé nǐ.
This style really suits you.
vocab.n: 換髮型 = change your look; the compliment 新髮型不錯喔 makes anyone's day.

x: 簡報以前要多練習。
Jiǎnbào yǐqián yào duō liànxí.
Practice plenty before the presentation.
我們先確認簡報的順序。
Wǒmen xiān quèrèn jiǎnbào de shùnxù.
Let's confirm the presentation order first.
vocab.n: 照順序 = in order; 順序錯了 = the sequence is wrong — engineering and slides alike.

x: 重點是交貨時間。
Zhòngdiǎn shì jiāohuò shíjiān.
The key point is delivery time.
vocab.n: 劃重點 = highlight the key parts; 重點是… = the bottom line is… Meeting-room essential.

vocab.e: division of labor; splitting up the work
x: 開會以前，我們先講好分工。
Kāihuì yǐqián, wǒmen xiān jiǎng hǎo fēngōng.
Before the meeting, let's settle who does what.
vocab.n: The teamwork question: 分工怎麼安排？ — who's covering what? Pairs with 合作 (cooperate).

x: 服務業占台灣經濟的六成以上。
Fúwùyè zhàn Táiwān jīngjì de liù chéng yǐshàng.
Services make up over 60% of Taiwan's economy.
vocab.n: The -業 suffix builds industries: 製造業 manufacturing, 科技業 tech, 餐飲業 F&B.

x: 缺工問題讓很多店縮短營業時間。
Quēgōng wèntí ràng hěnduō diàn suōduǎn yíngyè shíjiān.
The labor shortage has many shops cutting hours.
vocab.n: 缺 = to lack: 缺人 short-staffed, 缺貨 out of stock, 缺錢 broke. Headline regular since the pandemic.

x: 業者表示薪資已經調高了。
Yèzhě biǎoshì xīnzī yǐjīng tiáogāo le.
Operators say wages have already been raised.
vocab.n: News word; conversation says 薪水 xīnshuǐ. 調薪 = salary adjustment, 加薪 = a raise.

x: 人力不足是最大的問題。
Rénlì bùzú shì zuìdà de wèntí.
Insufficient manpower is the biggest problem.
vocab.n: 人力銀行 = job bank (104人力銀行 is Taiwan's biggest job site); 人力成本 labor costs.

x: 你這個新髮型帥爆欸！
Nǐ zhège xīn fǎxíng shuàibào éi!
This new cut of yours is INSANELY sharp!
slang.n: Taiwan youth: adjective + 爆 = to the point of exploding. 好吃爆, 累爆 — inflate anything.

x: 妳今天水噹噹，要去約會喔？
Nǐ jīntiān suí-tang-tang, yào qù yuēhuì o?
You're gorgeous today — got a date?
slang.n: Hokkien 媠 'beautiful' tripled for emphasis. Compliment aunties with it and gain a lifelong ally.

x: 剪完頭髮，你就是型男了。
Jiǎn wán tóufǎ, nǐ jiùshì xíngnán le.
One haircut and boom — certified stylish guy.
slang.n: Taiwan media-speak: 型 (style) + 男. Female version: 正妹 zhèngmèi.

x: 這家店的店員顏值都很高。
Zhè jiā diàn de diànyuán yánzhí dōu hěn gāo.
Everyone at this shop is ridiculously good-looking.
slang.n: Mainland internet ('face value'), fully current in Taiwan. 顏值高 = easy on the eyes; also for products and food plating.

x: 星期一早上，打工人上路了。
Xīngqí yī zǎoshang, dǎgōngrén shànglù le.
Monday morning — the worker-bee reports for duty.
slang.n: Mainland meme: the self-mocking salute of the salaried masses. 打工人，打工魂 — worker by body, worker by soul. Cousin of 社畜.
